notes: This contract pins the bounded embedded untimed federation-save control plane to the exact IEEE 1516.1-2025 C++ RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador declarations exported by the Requirements Lab. It covers initiation, per-federate save acknowledgements, completion/failure, abort, and status response only. The new three-member temporal case is limited to an untimed request and stable ordinary time-advance boundaries: each constrained recipient receives Initiate Federate Save directly before its Time Advance Grant, while the non-time-constrained recipient is queued only after all constrained recipients reach that boundary. The paired timed-save contract separately proves the analogous bounded TAR/TARA/NMR/NMRA and strict-actual-FQR behavior; neither contract establishes untimed Flush Queue Request admission, restored pending advances, role/membership churn, or a complete save/restore implementation. The paired restore-control tests save a live TSO retraction record, a terminal tombstone, a logical-time/actual-lookahead window, and one deferred lookahead-decrease target, but do not turn this control-plane contract into a complete save/restore claim. Durable snapshot serialization, complete restore semantics, save interlocks across every service, protected review, package support, and conformance remain open.
